Show it a mood board and set the direction for what you want to create. It gets it, it gets you. Tell it what you love and what you don't. It learns and adapts to your visual preferences. The more you use it, the better it gets. With unique controls to adjust its creativity, add randomness or surprise, or tune stylization. Craya 2 is meant to be a base for you to build on. A raw creative medium with no predefined preferences or opinions, and every control for you to make it your own.

02_spark.transcript: Everything starts with a spark. An idea. A sketch. A question. What if this could grow? That's where purposeful design begins, turning ideas into experiences, and experiences into growth. Users want clarity. Not clutter. Not waiting. Just flow and simplicity. From messy sketches to clean dashboards, design shapes the journey. We design intuitive interfaces, smart layouts, and clear actions. All crafted to move people forward. Because great design isn't just how it looks. It's how it works. Ready to grow?

03_renaissance.transcript: The 2030s will be the start of a new renaissance. Let's start! What can I explain? We all know AI is changing everything. New stations say we live in unprecedented times. What they don't realise is all of this has happened before. Do you plan to take over the world? The year is 1440 and this guy invents the printing press. A machine that brought knowledge, stories and scientific advancements to a scale the world had never seen before. Within a hundred years, 30,000 books turned into 200 million printed and spread across Europe. But that actually became a huge problem. Because once everyone was given the power to say anything, finding information wasn't difficult. Finding something meaningful was. Until eventually, this guy decided it was time for the rebirth of a lost human spirit. Or as the French say, as a renaissance. Where real art and knowledge became more important than endless tablets. But now our ways of communication are changing. Again, most companies believe the next rebirth of media belongs to those who pump out the most content the fastest. But we believe they're making the same mistake people made 500 years ago. Because the reason you treasure that handmade gift or cry at your favourite movie isn't because a machine pumped it out in a second. It's because they're made by real people putting in hours of effort, making things the scrappy and half-heart ways. Hilling stories that come from an honest human voice. We believe the next generation of brands won't win by just making more, they'll win by making things people actually care about. So, if this is the next renaissance, what part will you go?
